_why_interrupted: stopped after draw 3 to repair the capacity check, which compared occupied + need against the volume and so charged a resumed draw for the probes it was about to skip: with seven probes staged it read 16.70 + 23.85 = 40.55 GB against a 40 GB volume and refused draws 3 and 4 in under a minute each. The seven probes it verified are on the volume and are re-verified and skipped by the resumed run, whose record is the one a launch reads. This record is cost and failure history: the gate ignores it, because its terminal is not ALL_STAGED.
